compare_requests.method:
How much gathering simulations into one inference request changes a search, against how much a search changes
with nothing but its seed. On positions of three scripted eleven-round games, each searched as self-play searches a
decision: a fast search (150 simulations, no exploration noise) and a full one (800 simulations with exploration
noise), each with 1 simulation a request and seed 5, with 1 a request and seed 6, and with 8 and with 16 a
request and seed 5 (the same noise as the first). No depth limit. The evaluator, a stand-in network, gives every position priors and
values fixed by its zone input: priors exp(1.5 z) for standard normal z, and three values uniform in [-20, 20].
It reports the total variation distance between the root's visit shares and whether the most visited action is the
same. Run from the repository root with the training environment:
    tmp/gpu-mps-env/bin/python -B studies/campaign/runs/speed-256x16-2026-11-24/benchmarks/compare_requests.py OUT.json

reused_visits.method:
How many of a search's root visits come from the tree kept from the decisions before it, along games played by
self-play's search settings (800 simulations with noise on a quarter of the decisions, 150 on the rest, 8 a request,
no depth limit, the move drawn from the visit shares in game round 1 and the most visited after), with the stand-in
network of compare_requests.py. A search's root visits are its own simulations plus the visits its kept tree already
held at that state; KataGo's caps count the tree's nodes, kept ones included. Run from the repository root:
    tmp/gpu-mps-env/bin/python -B studies/campaign/runs/speed-256x16-2026-11-24/benchmarks/reused_visits.py OUT.json
